description: Prodger-Labs org preset. A repo uses it with: { "extends": ["local>Prodger-Labs/.github:renovate-config"] }.
Automerge is OFF by default. A repo opts in to patch automerge only if it has real CI and does not deploy on merge.
Repos that deploy on merge never automerge.

BEFORE onboarding a repo with an auto-merge workflow: make that workflow skip the Renovate bot (if: github.actor != 'renovate[bot]'), or set draftPR:true in the repo. Otherwise GitHub's native auto-merge merges Renovate PRs whatever this file says.
Dependabot: each repo's onboarding PR deletes the version-updates entries from .github/dependabot.yml. Dependabot alerts stay on.

packageRules.description: Third-party actions never automerge, even in a repo that opts in.
